connector.name: Whoop MCP by AshwanthramKL
connector.registryDescription: Read-only WHOOP v2 data for MCP clients, with local SQLite cache and CSV/JSONL/Parquet exports.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package whoop-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ashwanthramkl account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: WHOOP_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Client ID from your WHOOP developer app (https://developer-dashboard.whoop.com/apps/create).

env.name: WHOOP_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Client secret from your WHOOP developer app. Used for OAuth token refresh.

env.name: WHOOP_REDIRECT_URI
env.description: OAuth redirect URI. Defaults to http://localhost:8000/callback — only change if you registered a different URI.

env.name: WHOOP_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log level (DEBUG / INFO / WARNING / ERROR). Default INFO.

env.name: WHOOP_LOG_FILE
env.description: Path to the rotating log file. Set to empty string to disable file logging. Default ~/.whoop-mcp-server/logs/whoop-mcp.log.

env.name: WHOOP_LOG_JSON
env.description: Structured JSON logs (true) vs human-readable (false). Default true.
